name: mr5_sector_rel_loser
_hypothesis: Sector-relative contrarian, the mirror of mr4: fell last month AND has lagged its own sector over 63 days (negative weight on rs_vs_sector). Isolates idiosyncratic losers rather than stocks dragged down with their whole sector - the classic over-reaction candidate. rs_vs_sector has full coverage on the base universe, so the negative weight introduces no NaN bias.
